_comment: Shared by tests/test_diff_supersede_parity.py and frontend/src/utils/__tests__/diffSupersedeParity.test.ts. Each case is the diff fences of one message, in order. superseded lists [block, file-section] pairs a later diff for the same file replaces: the UI fades those (findSupersededDiffParts in frontend/src/utils/diffUtils.ts) and the diff-apply hold does not wait for them (_superseded_indices in app/utils/apply_ledger.py). Change one side only with the other. Every hunk header here is numeric; headers that carry only a section hint are rewritten by the client before detection and are covered on the server side in tests/test_await_diff_apply.py. Hunk markers are written as \u0040\u0040 so no line of this file looks like a hunk header to diff tooling.
